items.source: Build the FragmentsRendering instance.
items.translation: 构建 `FragmentsRendering` 实例。

items.source: viewName - the view name for the fragment
Defines a builder for FragmentsRendering.
items.translation: 定义了 `FragmentsRendering` 的构建器。

items.source: Add one or more header values under the given name.
items.translation: 在给定名称下添加一个或多个标头值。

items.source:
Provides access to every header declared so far with the possibility
to add, replace, or remove values.
items.translation: 提供对迄今为止声明的所有头的访问，并可以添加、替换或删除值。

items.source: Specify the status to use for the response.
items.translation: 指定要用于响应的状态。

items.source:
Add an HTML fragment. The fragment will use attributes from the shared
model for the request.
items.translation: 添加一个 HTML 片段。该片段将使用共享模型中的请求属性。

items.source: model - fragment attributes in addition to attributes from the shared model for the request
items.translation: model - 请求共享模型的属性之外的片段属性

items.source: fragment - the fragment to add; the fragment also inherits attributes from the shared model for the request
items.translation: fragment - 要添加的片段；该片段还会从请求的共享模型继承属性

items.source: fragments - the fragments to add; each fragment also inherits attributes from the shared model for the request
items.translation: fragments - 要添加的片段；每个片段还会从请求的共享模型继承属性

items.source: headersConsumer - the consumer to provide access to
